name: Michael R. Adams
office: Antelope Valley Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Michael R. Adams is the incumbent Area 4 trustee on the Antelope Valley Community College District Board of Trustees, having served over 17 years. His past roles include emergency services coordinator for Simi Valley, housing manager for Palmdale, and senior redevelopment projects coordinator for Lancaster. In a 2026 questionnaire, he proposed working with state officials to stabilize funding and encouraging administrators and unions to resolve disputes without legal remedies.
